bestBets.overview: SPANISH ARMADA should be primed at his third run back from a spell. He will park right over the speed and the drop back in trip looks a plus. TALK OF THRONES resumes from a long lay-off. His recent trial looked very slick and the blinkers go straight on. Expecting him to run well. SOVEREIGN ROCK showed ability last preparation and has been tuned up for his return with a nice trial win.  NIGHT BROKER makes his debut on the back of some encouraging trials and Pike rides.

raceTips.comment: Night Broker is a son of Siyouni on debut for Simon Miller who has a number of trials under the belt and the best showing he was able to produce (and only appearance in them to date) was when the shades went on back in March. Trialled without them most recent and still looked to do things well, shades on for the debut here and gets the services of William Pike in the saddle. Looks a 3YO with good natural ability, tactical speed and genuine upside in a race where there aren’t really any standouts, keen to see what he can do. Spanish Armada is knocking on the door but steps right back to 1100m here, doesn’t have electric early speed and loves to race over the pace so there is the potential he may need to take a sit here today over the sharper trip. Finitto Web found the top on return here and looked swallowed up halfway down the lane before kicking back to almost get the bob on the line when just nosed out by Super Sentai. Does rise a couple of kilos here with the senior going on but should only improve out of that performance and has shown enough to suggest there’s a maiden win in him this prep. Talk Of Thrones is first up off 484 days which is usually always something I’m happy to knock off such a long spell but he was utterly luckless the last time we saw him at the races back in April 2025 in what has since been a very much winner-producing maiden. Has had a couple of trials leading into his return of which the most recent was a marked improvement on the first and should have the tactical speed to posi up in a really strong position here in running from that low draw. Clearly got the ability, it’s just whether he might need this off the break under raceday pressure.

bestBets.overview: MAGNIFICENT PRINCE makes his debut on the back of three strong trial efforts. He should get a lovely run from a good draw and W Pike rides. ESPRESSO TIME parked wide throughout first-up and just missed. With a more economical run she can go one better. PROFOUND BENEFIT ran well first-up in what looks a deep maiden. CHATTAHOOCHIE should improve in her first-up run and the blinkers go on.

raceTips.comment: Tricky maiden this. Magnificent Prince is a 3YO on debut for Annaya Pateman who’s finished no worse than 2nd in 3 career trials and have really liked the way he’s covered the ground and stretched out late in all of them. Drawn well, gets the 3YO weight allowance in an all aged maiden and the booking of Pike really catches the eye, shown signs he’s got good ability. Espresso Time looks a strong chance off a really good trial and a wide run throughout on return but stuck on super and came again late on the line to really just miss behind Super Sentai. Barrier hurts but he’s got speed and anticipate Chanel Cooper looks to burn across early again here, should only improve if she can get in. Chattahoochie gets shades on fist time after a plain-ish return behind Super Sentai. Think she’s better than that and she’s drawn to get every conceivable here to bounce back with the gear change. Perfume Princess gets a tongue tie applied so there may have been a few issues found following her disappointing return where she just wanted to overdo things. Some of her runs as a juvenile would be more than good enough to be in the finish here particularly given after the claim she’s only got 50.5kgs on her back and didn’t think her trial prior to her run on return was too inferior to that of Godspeed in the same heat who has really burst onto the 3YO scene in recent weeks.

bestBets.overview: DIGGERS SHOUT was heavily supported in the betting on debut and ran well in what has turned out to be to be a very strong race. He improves off that run and Pike retains the ride. ROLLWITHTHEPUNCHES was a completed forgive run on debut where he settled at the tail and never got warm. His trials leading into that event were strong so no surprise to see him improve sharply on that effort. LAKE BAIKAL makes her debut on the back of some nice trial efforts. ROCKTEX next best.

raceTips.comment: Rollwiththepunches was one of the better 12th of 13 runs you’ll see on debut. Drew very wide, stepped a touch slow, settled a mile off them in transit while also being a bit all over the place in the straight but was hard to miss how he picked himself up and motored home his final furlong once he got into his work. He stepped cleaner in his trials prior, trials that were elite and think if Tash can just get him to step a touch cleaner and keep him within striking distance in running, he’s a big chance in this as a horse that looks to have plenty of raw ability, just may be a work in progress in harnessing it. Diggers Shout stuck on well on debut in 2YO Saturday company at 1200m and those are the right formlines with the winner They’reallsisters and the 2nd horse Godspeed utterly bolting in over the weekend gone at his second outing. Pike sticking a real positive, looks a horse with some real upside. Lake Baikal caught the eye late in his most recent 1000m trial at Belmont leading into his debut, really liked the way he worked home and the soft draw is ideal first time to the races. Clear Assault chased home an impressive subsequent winner in Properata in her most recent trial which was run in a very slick time and she’ll do no work at all following the fenceline in the run drawn the pole.

bestBets.overview: SIN CITY BOY stepped up in trip last start and finished strongly. He should improve off that run and go very close again. THANGOO gets a staying trip at only his third start which is a query however he does look like he will stay all day. HE'SNOTALLTHERE will park close to the speed and give a kick. DELICATE WARRIOR next best.

raceTips.comment: Thangoo came on in leaps and bounds at his second career run stepping up to the 1700m when finding the front, rolling them along and making a very progressive galloper in Dirty Habits work to get past him in the straight. He’s a big, raw animal who gives the impression these trips could be his go in time and should only continue to improve the more racing they get under his belt. Sin City Boy put in a career best effort last start behind Luka Magic out to the 2200m for the first time, loved the way that he closed off and showed that with the right run from the wide draw he’s going to be a force in the finish here. He’snotallthere stuck on well over this trip last start and now gets the services of William Pike who can either kick through to lead and control or box-seat drawn the pole. Delicate Warrior is knocking on the door and some of the formlines out of the races he’s contested this campaign read up super. Great map but is on trial at the 2200m for the first time.

bestBets.overview: CELESTIAL BOOM ran well first-up. She improves off that run, draws the inside draw and Pike rides. BEND IT LIKE BECKS has been given a freshen-up since failing to handle the rise in class. Back to maiden grade he should run well. SUPAROO will park off the speed and find the line strongly. FIELD MISTRESS is rock hard fit and racing well.

raceTips.comment: Bend It Like Becks has been freshened up a month dropping back to a mile after being thrown in the deep end at 2000m in the Aquanita Stakes and probably not handling the rise in class or the breakneck tempo at which that race was run. His 3 runs prior to that were all very good without winning and think this looks a very winnable assignment for him if he’s bounced out of that little break in good order. Celestial Boom ran well on return at start #2 and thought the way she stretched out late she gave the impression she’s looking for more ground. Pike on, barrier 1, out to a mile, lightly raced and in the right camp to keep improving, no surprise to see her very popular in betting. History Supreme is on debut for the astute JK Racing yard and while never one to read too much into the 1450m trials, liked the way he covered the ground in what was a really soft winning trial performance back on the 27th of July, looks to have some scope. Field Mistress is banging down the door to win one but thought her run came to an end late over the 1675m at Bunbury last Thursday. On the back-up and can settle closer here from the draw, has been due to draw a gate this prep and finally has one to work with!

bestBets.overview: Keen on MARCOS in this race. He returned to racing with a narrow but impressive win in what looked a deep 2YO maiden. He improves off that run and draws to get every chance. FLYING MARADONA led and won well first-up. From gate 1 he can fire straight to the front and go close again. RISING FAME rolls forward and can give a sight on the speed. ARTIE'S STORM next best.

raceTips.comment: Marcos let down super to win a pretty handy little 2YO maiden on return and only rises 0.5kg here into CL1 company with a barrier to work with. Looks another great set-up for him to win back to back races for this now 3YO who has always showed glimpses of real promise and might be ready now off the back of a host of gear changes leading into last start to put it all together. Flying Maradona got into a lovely rhythm setting a strong tempo at the head of the field on return to the races and simply ran them off their legs. Rolled them along 5L faster than average to the 600m and just didn’t stop, impressive when you factor in he was only first up. Might be the way to ride him with Pike jumping on from 1, anticipate he’ll look to do something similar here, only slight concern for mine being whether he may already be looking for further off the back of that? Looks every bit a middle-distance type in time. Next Destination couldn’t have got home better last start at Bunbury given the race-shape from barrier 11 of 11 over the 1100m behind Cinque Stelle. Drops back into a CL1, steps out to 1300m and importantly draws a barrier, looks a much more suitable set up for her. Artie’s Storm was doing her best work late on WA debut behind Flash Dancer but the run didn’t exactly scream be on me next start despite the fact she should really take some good improvement out of it.

bestBets.overview: DESERT DANCING should be primed for this at her fourth run back from a spell. At her most recent outing she settled off the speed and found the line well in what looked a collectively deeper race than this. FANTAXTIC is a lightly raced sprinter who attacks this fresh for a new stable. He looked sharp in a recent trial win. RETURN OF THE MACH has ability and resumes from a spell with the benefit of a solid trial and Pike rides.  LET'S TALK can improve sharply on his first-up effort.

raceTips.comment: Wide open CL5 for the sprinters, could make a genuine case for 8 of the 9 here. Hoping the Bairstow’s might’ve struck a bit of form as giving Yamashita’s Gold a hope here on WA debut. Purchased in an Inglis Online Sale for 47.5k, he’s a lightly raced 4YO who is a CL1 winner at Pakenham and has raced in and around some solid company over in VIC before changing hands. Liked how he hit the line in what was a very slick trial heat down at Lark Hill back in late July and think he can make his presence felt here from a low draw if he’s wound up enough, happy to have a throw at the stumps with him. Later Alligator was a first up Westspeed Platinum winner at cricket score odds last campaign off the back of two trials leading in and reckon he’s trialled up better (also had a pair of trials) this time around for his return. Looks a big price touching double figures when you delve through some of his formlines from even deeper into his last campaign of racing as well. Desert Dancing is going to need a race run to suit from her likely settling position from the wide draw but loves racing here at Northam and she’s got a booming finish on her, she’ll be launching a run at them late and 1100m suits her better than the five furlongs. Fantaxtic has looked a different horse in the care of Mitch Pateman, loved the sharpness of the trial leading into his return as well and should just about enjoy the run of the race here. No shortage of winning chances in this.

bestBets.overview: ETERNAL ROMANCE has run well in both starts  this time in and should be primed for this at her third run back from a spell. COSMIC ECLIPSE will park off the speed and find the line well. HANAFUBUKI has shown ability in Victoria and makes her local debut without  a trial. GONDRINKIN next best.

raceTips.comment: Hanafubuki steps out for the first time for Aaron Mitchell here in the West as a staying mare who stretched out as far as 3000m last campaign over in VIC and actually ran some really brave races before changing hands with the new team forking out 32.5k for her online. Ran a cracker first up, no trial at the Heath over 1600m in BM66 company last campaign and that’s exactly the formula Aaron follows with her here as well in what isn’t an overly strong CL3 mile by any means. With that freshness in the legs she should be finishing off strongly. Eternal Romance has come back in very good order. 2nd on a bottomless track first up behind Berry Blast over 1400m before stepping up to a mile last start when up in grade and running 4th behind Sisu Spirit & Our Mate Archie. Really good form for this, drops back to a CL3 and should be just about ready to peak now third up, just might be looking for a touch further before we see her best? Pretty dour, grindy mare who will keep whacking away. Gondrinkin is going as well as he could be for Ash Maley and has shown some versatility in his runs this campaign. Rock-hard fit, drawn soft, will grind it out once again. Lathams Wish brings a bit of intrigue first up no trial at a mile. Thought he was very good first up in a much stronger CL3 doing his best late over 1400m the last time we saw him at the races. Bars on not ideal but could get under the guard somewhat here if he’s forward enough despite the lack of continuity with his preparation thus far.
